events.summary: Tata Consultancy Services Limited has issued a reminder regarding the transfer of unclaimed dividends and equity shares to the Investor Education and Protection Fund Authority. This action pertains to the Third Interim Dividend for the fiscal year 2019-20. Shareholders whose dividends have remained unclaimed for seven consecutive years are required to claim the amounts by February 16, 2027. Failure to claim by this date will result in the transfer of shares and dividends to the IEPF without further notice. Shares held in physical form will be dematerialized and transferred, while shares in demat form will be transferred via corporate action. Original share certificates for physical holdings will be deemed cancelled. Details of unclaimed dividends are available on the company website.
